g.id: cluster_Challenge Layer — one isolated network per live challenge
g.text: Challenge Layer — one isolated network per live challenge
Solid arrows = network communication paths. Dotted arrows = artefact dependency:
the artefact recovered in Stage N is required to begin Stage N+1 (enforced by
Green = static artefact served by CTFd (no live service). Red = live container on
its own isolated Docker network. Blue = control plane.
Isolation: stage3-net and stage6-net have no route to each other or to rtr-control.
Challenge containers cannot reach CTFd, MariaDB, or the static artefact store.
